channel.title: Utrecht Beslist — City Council Decisions (Health & Welfare)
channel.description: Utrecht city council decisions and documents explained in plain language.

item.title: Adopt Wmo Regulation 2027
item.description: The council is deciding on the new Verordening maatschappelijke ondersteuning 2027. The rules become clearer and more accessible for residents and professionals. Clear criteria and new rules for the own contribution are introduced.

item.title: Audit report on household help
item.description: The Rekenkamer investigated household help services in Utrecht. The report 'Stof tot nadenken' contains seven recommendations to improve services. The council is asked to request the municipal executive to implement these recommendations.
